    """Draw a color-1 rightward ray from horizontally extended exposed ends."""
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if grid[r][c] == bg:
                c += 1
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            start = c
            while c + 1 < w and grid[r][c + 1] == color:
                c += 1
            end = c
            # Only horizontal runs of length at least two cast a ray; the
            # right endpoint must not be supported vertically by this color.
            if end > start and (r == 0 or grid[r - 1][end] != color) and \
                    (r + 1 == h or grid[r + 1][end] != color):
                cc = end + 1
                while cc < w and grid[r][cc] == bg:
                    out[r][cc] = 1
                    cc += 1
            c += 1
    return out
